project_type: FastAPI Python backend (app/) + vanilla HTML/JS static frontend (static/)
build_system: No build step. Dependencies: pip install -r requirements.txt. Server: uvicorn app.main:app --reload
test_framework: No automated test suite present. Verification is manual: start the server and curl/check endpoints.
verification_instructions: 1) Start server: uvicorn app.main:app --reload. 2) GET /health → {status:ok}. 3) Test each endpoint manually per FEAT verification steps. No pytest/unittest files exist.
environment_constraints: DATABASE_URL must be set for DB operations. PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY required for Paystack calls. RESEND_API_KEY for email. In dev without these, most endpoints return 503 gracefully — that is expected and acceptable.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md. Keep changes surgical — no refactoring outside the specific bugs. Match existing code style (no type hints on new vars, f-strings, logger.debug for non-fatal errors).
key_patterns: All DB calls use 'with get_db() as conn: with conn.cursor(...) as cur:' pattern. Non-fatal errors are caught and logged with logger.debug/logger.warning — never re-raised. Email sends are non-blocking via _dispatch_async. Route handlers use Depends(get_current_user) for auth; user=None means unauthenticated. Error responses use raise HTTPException(status_code=..., detail=...) which main.py maps to {error: ...} JSON.
directory_structure: app/ = all Python backend (main.py is the FastAPI app, db.py is the DB layer, paystack.py is DVA helpers, services/email_service.py is the email provider). static/ = all HTML/CSS/JS served directly by FastAPI. .agents/tasks/ = workflow artifacts (do not commit). _diag_admin.py, _diag_admin2.py = orphan diagnostic scripts to delete.
